editor_note: All six rewritten entries (9, 44, 65, 67, 68, 69) keep their meaning. Nothing is inverted, dropped or added: the integer-bounds condition, error codes 4710 and 4712, the postprocessing value mapping with its unchanged default of 3, and the before/after_transpilation split all match the English. There is one wording problem in entry 67. "Breaking changes" is rendered as "Zásadní změny", which means "major/fundamental changes" and loses the point that these changes break backward compatibility. Czech changelogs normally say "Nekompatibilní změny" or "Změny narušující kompatibilitu".

examples.why: 'Zásadní' means 'major/fundamental' and does not tell the reader that existing code using `model`, `obj_value` or `postprocessing` will stop working. 'Nekompatibilní změny' is the usual Czech changelog term for breaking changes.

editor_note: The rewritten entry 28 keeps the meaning of the English. QPU time is still minimal and almost constant, there is one round of QAOA, and the parameters are optimized on a CPU. Two small edits remain. First, the problem name is written in lowercase as "úlohy market split", while the rest of the page uses "Market Split" (entries 24, 25, 29 and 58). Second, "v sekci popisu" is a stiff, word-for-word rendering of "in the description section"; a Czech writer would refer to the section by its heading, as in "v části Popis".

examples.line_approx: Tabulka 1: Výkonnostní metriky pro různé instance úlohy market split.
examples.source: Performance metrics for different instances of the market split problem.
examples.translation: Výkonnostní metriky pro různé instance úlohy market split.
examples.suggested: Výkonnostní metriky pro různé instance úlohy Market Split.
examples.why: Everywhere else on the page the problem name is written "Market Split" (heading 24, entries 25, 29, 58). Writing it in lowercase here only in the caption is inconsistent.

examples.line_approx: Jak již bylo zmíněno v sekci popisu, ...
examples.source: As mentioned previously in the description section,
examples.translation: Jak již bylo zmíněno v sekci popisu,
examples.suggested: Jak již bylo zmíněno v části Popis,
examples.why: "v sekci popisu" copies the English word for word. Czech technical writing names the section by its heading ("Popis", entry 11).

editor_note: None of the three rewritten entries (40, 41, 44) would mislead a learner. All the numbers and caveats carry over: <10 % at width 9 (10 qubits), 80–90 %, widths near 60, about 15 %, N = 50 (51 qubits), one job. There are three small slips. Entry 41 drops "near" in "Orbit zůstává na 80–90 %". Entry 44 renders "size sweep" as "měření přes různé velikosti", and "měření" is easy to misread as quantum measurement on this page. Entry 44 also has a calqued "51 qubitů celkem" and uses "výchozím nastavením Orbit" where entry 38 has the inflected "Orbitu". Separately, entry 40 says "Bernsteinova-Vaziraniho algoritmu" while entry 41 and the rest of the page say "algoritmus Bernstein-Vazirani".

examples.why: The approximating qualifier "near" was dropped, so a representative figure now reads as an exact range. This is a dropped qualifier, not a reversal of meaning.

examples.source: this tutorial does not rerun a size sweep ... (51 total qubits in this circuit)
examples.translation: tento tutoriál nespouští znovu celé měření přes různé velikosti ... (51 qubitů celkem v tomto obvodu)
examples.suggested: tento tutoriál znovu neprovádí sérii běhů pro různé velikosti ... (v tomto obvodu celkem 51 qubitů)
examples.why: On a page about quantum measurement, "měření" for "sweep" can be read as qubit measurement. "51 qubitů celkem" copies the English word order, while natural Czech puts "celkem" first.

examples.translation: Škálování Bernsteinova-Vaziraniho algoritmu na větší velikosti
examples.suggested: Škálování algoritmu Bernstein-Vazirani na větší velikosti
examples.why: The heading uses the declined possessive, but the next entry (41) and the rest of the page use the invariant "algoritmus/obvod Bernstein-Vazirani". The heading should match.

editor_note: Both rewritten entries keep the meaning of the English. Entry 72 keeps Q as the control and Alice's qubit as the target of the CNOT, and the Hadamard still comes after it on Q. Entry 73's prose ("Protože A a Q jsou na stejném místě, seskupme výše uvedené členy podle výsledků měření qubitů A a Q") is accurate and natural. The one thing a Czech editor would change is in entry 72: "řídícím" should be "řídicím". "Řídicí" is the purpose adjective for a control qubit, while "řídící" means "currently controlling/driving". Entry 64 has the same spelling, so the file is consistent but uses the non-standard form.

examples.source: a CNOT gate with Q as the control and her own qubit as the target
examples.translation: hradlo CNOT se Q jako řídícím a svým qubitem jako cílovým
examples.suggested: hradlo CNOT s Q jako řídicím a svým qubitem jako cílovým
examples.why: Standard Czech spelling for a control qubit or gate is the purpose adjective 'řídicí' (short i). 'Řídící' is the present-participle form ('one that is controlling'). 's Q' also reads more naturally than 'se Q'. This does not change the meaning.

editor_note: I checked the three rewritten entries for naturalness and meaning (deep checks 1 and 3). None of them misleads: entry 53 correctly says to fix `seed_transpiler` for reproducible mapping ("nastav pevnou hodnotu volby"), and entry 78 keeps the degenerate optima, the first-solution-only caveat and the bitstring/variable_mapping relation. Two wording slips remain. In [78], "Zde je uvažováno pouze první řešení, adresované názvem proměnné" uses a stiff passive and a calqued, singular "adresované názvem proměnné"; it should say that the solution is indexed by variable names. In [87], "všech funkcí" for "all function features" can be read as "all functions" rather than "all features of this function".

examples.source: Only the first solution is considered here, addressed by variable name.
examples.translation: Zde je uvažováno pouze první řešení, adresované názvem proměnné.
examples.suggested: Zde uvažujeme pouze první řešení, jehož hodnoty jsou indexované podle názvů proměnných.
examples.why: The passive is stiff, and the calqued singular 'adresované názvem proměnné' hides that the solution is keyed by variable names.

examples.source: for a detailed walkthrough of all function features
examples.translation: Podrobný přehled všech funkcí najdeš v ...
examples.suggested: Podrobný průvodce všemi možnostmi této funkce najdeš v ...
examples.why: In Czech, 'funkce' means both 'feature' and 'function', so 'všech funkcí' reads as 'all functions' instead of 'all features of this Qiskit Function'.

editor_note: Entry 60 says the same thing as the English and would not mislead a learner: "Benchmark věrnosti procesu QFT" correctly renders "benchmark QFT process fidelity", and Orbit is still credited to Quantum Elements. There are two small problems. First, the apposition "funkce Qiskit" is in the nominative but follows "s Orbit", so it should be instrumental ("funkcí"); as written, a Czech reader sees a case mismatch. Second, "a Qiskit Function" is the product name, which house style keeps in English, so a phrase like "pomocí Orbit, Qiskit Function od Quantum Elements" reads better and keeps the product name in English.

examples.source: Benchmark QFT process fidelity with Orbit, a Qiskit Function by Quantum Elements
examples.translation: Benchmark věrnosti procesu QFT s Orbit, funkce Qiskit od Quantum Elements
examples.suggested: Benchmark věrnosti procesu QFT pomocí Orbit, Qiskit Function od Quantum Elements
examples.why: The apposition 'funkce' is nominative but follows 's Orbit', so its case should be instrumental ('funkcí'). The word 'pomocí' gets around the problem that the indeclinable 'Orbit' cannot show its case.
Qiskit Functions is on the house list of names kept in English (ALWAYS_ENGLISH_NAMES). Other entries keep it in English, for example entries 53 and 54 ('Qiskit Functions') and entry 57.

editor_note: The rewritten entry 12 says the same thing as the English. It keeps the random positive and negative couplings, the triangular example, the point that not all interactions can be minimized at once, and the global compounding into a "síť protichůdných omezení". Nothing in it would mislead a learner. There is one misspelled word: "v trojúhelníkových uspořádáích" should be "uspořádáních". The last sentence also inserts the clause "protože každý spin interaguje s každým jiným spinem" between "V SK modelu" and "se tato frustrace kumuluje", which follows the English word order and reads stiffly in Czech.

examples.why: Misspelled word: the locative plural of 'uspořádání' is 'uspořádáních'. The current form is not a Czech word.

examples.source: In the SK model, because every spin interacts with every other spin, this frustration is compounded globally, leading to a web of conflicting constraints.
examples.translation: V SK modelu, protože každý spin interaguje s každým jiným spinem, se tato frustrace kumuluje globálně, což vede k síti protichůdných omezení.
examples.suggested: Protože v SK modelu interaguje každý spin s každým, frustrace se kumuluje globálně a vzniká síť protichůdných omezení.
examples.why: The clause placed between 'V SK modelu' and the reflexive 'se' copies the English word order and reads stiffly. The meaning is correct.

editor_note: None of the 23 rewritten entries changes the meaning. The numbers (921 600 shots, 300 PUBs, 60 PUBs per N), conditions and caveats all match the English, including the O(n^2) vs O(n) argument in [17] and the "not a performance guarantee" note in [21]. The real problem is 'child job(s)'. Entries [5] and [11] leave it in English and attach Czech grammar to it ("v jedné child job"), while [4], [32], [46], [49] and [51] use 'podřízená úloha'. 'Transpiler' also switches between 'transpiler' ([33]) and 'transpilátor' ([42], [56]). Smaller things: [11] is a stiff calque, [0] and [10] use the hyphenated calque 'Orbit-vylepšená', and [32] renders 'default sweep' as 'Výchozí měření', which can be confused with quantum measurement.

examples.source: partitioning circuit sizes across three Runtime Batch child jobs [[5]]. Each fixed-size comparison remains in one child job
examples.translation: rozdělením velikostí obvodů do tří Runtime Batch child jobs [[5]]. Každé porovnání pevné velikosti zůstává v jedné child job
examples.suggested: rozdělením velikostí obvodů do tří podřízených úloh Runtime Batch [[5]]. Každé porovnání pro pevnou velikost zůstává v jedné podřízené úloze
examples.why: Elsewhere in the file 'child job' is 'podřízená úloha' ([4], [32], [49], [51]). Here it stays English and takes Czech feminine agreement.

examples.source: while keeping every fixed-size three-strategy comparison in one child job
examples.translation: při zachování všech tří strategií porovnání pro pevnou velikost v jedné child job
examples.suggested: přičemž každé porovnání tří strategií pro danou velikost zůstane v jedné podřízené úloze
examples.why: Stiff calque that reorders the phrase into 'all three comparison strategies' and keeps the English 'child job'.

examples.source: unitary QFT on the transpiler's selected layout
examples.translation: unitární QFT na rozvržení vybraném transpilátorem
examples.suggested: pick one form, 'transpiler' or 'transpilátor', and use it throughout
examples.why: [33] uses 'transpiler Qiskit' but [42] and [56] use 'transpilátor', so the same term appears in two forms in one file.

examples.source: The default sweep therefore evaluates 15 circuit sizes
examples.translation: Výchozí měření tedy vyhodnocuje 15 velikostí obvodů
examples.suggested: Výchozí průchod parametry tedy vyhodnocuje 15 velikostí obvodů
examples.why: 'Měření' can be read as quantum measurement in a page full of mid-circuit measurements. 'Sweep' means a pass over a range of parameters.
